name: inverter-bench-stiff
title: Bench sequence on a stiff grid (no impedance)
purpose: Ideal 400 V bus, output filter 500 µH without chokes (bench board), a stiff grid (no impedance), duty limits 0.05–0.95. The application runs the bench stages: OFF at t = 0, step 1 at 10 ms, step 2 at 1.3 s (10 periods of settling, relay commanded ahead of a zero crossing, contact 9.7 ms later, feedback 20 ms after the command), injection of 0.1 A (the application's bench cap) at 1.6 s. Checks the connection and the current loop.
